title: Playboy Lot of 4 Mimi Rogers Bo Derek Anne Rice Laura Dern 1993 1994 + 1 Bonus
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 original vintage Playboy magazines from 1993 and 1994 featuring memorable celebrity covers, pictorials, interviews and pop-culture features from the early 1990s.

March 1993 – Mimi Rogers
Features actress Mimi Rogers in the cover pictorial, along with a Playboy Interview with Anne Rice and 20 Questions with Laura Dern. Also includes features on modern love, upscale strip clubs and Vietnam veteran Ron Ridenhour. Rogers’ March 1993 appearance was a notable celebrity pictorial in which she had approval over the photo shoot. 

August 1993 – Pamela Anderson / Dan Aykroyd
Memorable Coneheads-themed issue featuring Pamela Anderson with Dan Aykroyd on the cover. Includes a Playboy Interview with Dan Aykroyd, the Lady Lifeguards pictorial, Jennifer Lavoie as Playmate of the Month and additional features. This is one of the more distinctive celebrity covers of the early 1990s and is commonly cataloged as the Pamela Anderson/Dan Aykroyd issue. 

August 1994 – NYPD Nude / Carol Shaya
Features New York police officer Carol Shaya in the well-known NYPD Nude pictorial and cover. Also includes a Playboy Interview with NFL star Deion Sanders, Maria Checa as Playmate of the Month, the Models of Milan pictorial, a Dr. Jack Kevorkian feature and 20 Questions with Dana Delany. Shaya’s Playboy appearance became controversial within the NYPD and generated significant publicity at the time. 

December 1994 – Bo Derek Gala Christmas Issue
Gala Christmas issue featuring actress Bo Derek on the cover and in a pictorial. Also includes a Garry Shandling Playboy Interview, Roger Ebert on Tom Hanks, Vincent Bugliosi on the legal system, Sex Stars of 1994 and other year-end features. 

All four are original newsstand editions with visible UPC/barcodes.

Pre-owned vintage condition with normal signs of age, storage and handling. There is visible surface wear, light scratching/scuffing and some edge/corner wear, particularly noticeable on the August 1994 issue. The December 1994 metallic cover also shows surface/reflection wear. Overall, the magazines still present nicely for their age.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.

Good collectible lot for fans of vintage Playboy, Pamela Anderson, Mimi Rogers, Bo Derek, Deion Sanders, Dan Aykroyd and 1990s entertainment and pop culture.
